=== expr-mul
--- main
!$x = 2 * 3
A -> B : $x
=== expr-precedence
--- main
!$a = 1 + 2 * 3
!$b = (1 + 2) * 3
!$c = 10 - 2 - 3
!$d = 100 / 10 / 5
!$e = 2 * 3 + 4 * 5
!$f = 7 / 2
!$g = -7 / 2
!$h = 1 - -1
A : $a $b $c $d $e $f $g $h
=== expr-compare-int
--- main
!$a = 1 < 2
!$b = 2 < 1
!$c = 2 <= 2
!$d = 3 >= 4
!$e = 3 > 2
!$f = 3 == 3
!$g = 3 != 3
!$h = 1 + 1 == 2
A : $a $b $c $d $e $f $g $h
=== expr-compare-string
--- main
!$a = "abc" < "abd"
!$b = "b" > "a"
!$c = "abc" == "abc"
!$d = "abc" != "abd"
!$e = "10" < "9"
!$f = "Z" < "a"
!$g = "é" > "z"
A : $a $b $c $d $e $f $g
=== expr-compare-mixed
--- main
!$a = 10 < "9"
!$b = "10" == 10
!$c = 2 == "2"
A : $a $b $c
=== expr-logic
--- main
!$a = 1 && 0
!$b = 1 || 0
!$c = 0 || 0
!$d = 1 && 2
!$e = "" || "x"
!$f = "a" && ""
!$g = 1 < 2 && 2 < 3
!$h = 1 > 2 || 2 > 3 && 1
A : $a $b $c $d $e $f $g $h
=== expr-string-concat
--- main
!$a = "foo" + "bar"
!$b = "foo" + 1
!$c = 1 + "foo"
!$d = "a" - "b"
!$e = "a" * "b"
!$f = "a" / "b"
!$g = "x" + 1 + 2
!$h = 1 + 2 + "x"
A : $a|$b|$c|$d|$e|$f|$g|$h
=== expr-negative
--- main
!$a = -5
!$b = -5 + 3
!$c = 3 - 5
!$d = 3-5
!$e = 3 -5
!$f = (-5)
!$g = 2 * -3
A : $a $b $c $d $e $f $g
=== expr-int-overflow
--- main
!$a = 2147483647 + 1
!$b = 65536 * 65536
!$c = -2147483647 - 2
!$d = 2147483647 * 2
A : $a $b $c $d
=== expr-int-parse-overflow
--- main
!$a = 2147483648
A : $a
=== expr-division-by-zero
--- main
!$a = 1 / 0
A : $a
=== expr-division-by-zero-in-text
--- main
!function $div($a, $b)
!return $a / $b
!endfunction
A : $div(1, 0)
=== expr-single-quotes
--- main
!$a = 'hello'
!$b = 'it"s'
!$c = "it's"
A : $a $b $c
=== expr-spaces
--- main
!$a=1+2
!$b   =   3   *   4
!$c = ( 1 + 2 ) * ( 3 + 4 )
A : $a $b $c
=== expr-unquoted-word
--- main
!$a = foo
!$b = foo.bar
!$c = $undefined
A : $a $b $c
=== expr-syntax-error-word
--- main
!$a = foo bar-baz!
A : $a
=== expr-two-values
--- main
!$a = 1 2
!$b = "x" "y"
A : $a $b
=== expr-missing
--- main
!$a =
A : $a
=== expr-unclosed-string
--- main
!$a = "abc
A : $a
=== expr-unbalanced-paren
--- main
!$a = (1 + 2
A : $a
=== expr-extra-close-paren
--- main
!$a = 1 + 2)
A : $a
=== expr-operator-only
--- main
!$a = +
A : $a
=== expr-dangling-operator
--- main
!$a = 1 +
A : $a
=== expr-minus-alone
--- main
!$a = -
A : $a
=== expr-nested-parens
--- main
!$a = ((((1))))
!$b = (2 + (3 * (4 - 1)))
A : $a $b
=== expr-bool-in-if
--- main
!if 0
A : zero
!endif
!if ""
A : empty
!endif
!if "0"
A : string zero
!endif
!if 1
A : one
!endif
=== expr-not-equals-vs-bang
--- main
!$a = 1 != 2
!$b = !1
A : $a
=== expr-leading-zero
--- main
!$a = 007
!$b = 007 + 1
A : $a $b
=== expr-unicode-digits
--- main
!$a = %intval("١٢٣")
!$b = %intval("+5")
!$c = %intval("-0")
A : $a $b $c
=== expr-commercial-minus
--- main
!$a = 5⁒3
A : $a
=== expr-nbsp-space
--- escaped
--- main
!$a = 1 + 2
A : $a
=== expr-assignment-in-expression
--- main
!$a = 1 = 2
A : $a
=== expr-eval-builtin
--- main
!$a = %eval("1+2*3")
!$b = %eval("\"x\"")
!$c = %eval("10/3")
A : $a $b $c
=== expr-eval-error
--- main
!$a = %eval("1+")
A : $a
=== expr-eval-unknown-function
--- main
!$a = %eval("$nofunc(1)")
A : $a
=== expr-string-compare-surrogates
--- escaped
--- main
!$a = "\ud83d\ude00" > "\uffff"
A : $a
